content.title-intro: NP NAPHTHA Production and Trading Company Limited
content.body-intro2: NP NAPHTHA company's predecessor was GREEN RUBBER COMPANY, established in 2008, in the context of the growing development of Japanese, American supermarket corporations and Vendors, the need to link with supply partners. Services and products of factories and corporations are very large and very diverse. NP NAPHTHA Company constantly improves production, enhances quality and reduces product costs, to work with partners to bring to the market good quality and low-cost products.
content.body-intro1: NP NAPHTHA Production and Trading Company Limited is a company specializing in manufacturing and processing for Vendors of large corporations and providing technical rubber products. In addition, we also expand products in the wharf, bridge and road industry and other specialized rubber products such as Slope, speed reducer, and anti-collision cushion for wharf (Rubber Fender).
content.ORIENTED-DEVELOPMENT-BODY1: The vision and mission set by NP NAPHTHA are always the guiding principles for NPNAPHTHA's activities. We are always diligent and creative in our work, dedicated to our customers and partners, and constantly upgrade machinery, equipment as well as facility systems to be modern, efficient and safe.
content.ORIENTED-DEVELOPMENT-BODY2: NP NAPHTHA always brings satisfaction to domestic and foreign customers and partners. Determined to strive to become the leading unit providing comprehensive services for Vendors and large corporations in Japan and the US
